title: IT-chapter Aeronautical Adventures
description: This is a modpack for the IT-chapter of KTHs Create Aeronautics server. Featuring cutting edge mods, proceed with caution!
body:
The IT-chapter of KTHs Create + Create: Simulated modpack for server use. For whitelist, please use the correct contact forms on Discord. 

Includes performance mods to run nicely on lower end computers. Includes optifine-style options and ComputerCraft for integrating what you learned in school.
